tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All the general terms & conditions are uploaded in the tender document. Please go through it & upload duly sealed & signed tender document compliance sheet & specification compliance sheet.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder shall have successfully supplied turbine spares / MOP spares to any thermal power station of 210 MW or above capacity of value not less than Rs. 13.82 lakhs in any one year of the preceding five financial years i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). As a proof purchase order copies (Single/Multiple (max.3)) for any one of the said financial year during which supplies are made shall be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant PQR documents shall be furnished

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder shall be BHEL / L&T / AMCO / SIEMENS / DYNAMIC manufacturers of 210MW KWU turbine spares / MOP spares. As a proof bidder shall upload valid registration certificate issued by the Competent Authority / relevant documents in e-portal.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant PQR documents shall be furnished

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The average annual financial turnover of the tenderer should not be less than Rs. 27.76 lakhs (Rs. 13.88 lakhs for Micro & Small Enterprise) during last 3 preceding financial years (last 2 preceding financial years respect to Micro & Small Enterprise). As a proof, the bidder shall upload certified copy of Annual turnover certificate/ P&L statement duly certified by Chartered Accountant.
